svg.title: Spaces and optional Cloud space management
svg.desc: The local app implements start and move requests to Cloud. Space management and ordinary space participation have separate authority. Move archives go from the local server directly to the returned space upload target. Contract support does not establish deployment availability.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Local DorkOS app + server
Start / move UI + Cloud relay implemented
Agents execute here

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Optional Cloud space management
Public /v1/communities contract
Availability checked independently

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

Notice-gated space deletion
